zh-CN.title: 探索者外观 · 小哀表情

新一与柯南改用月光掠影切换，修复新一左脚被裁掉的问题
气泡边框新增 APTX 药丸装饰，移除头像分区、分隔线和旧版金光效果

en.title: Explorer styles · Ai expressions
items: Ten Ai expressions appear at the start of messages, matching the text size and flowing naturally with it
Shinichi and Conan switch through a moonlight sweep; Shinichi's left foot is no longer cropped out
Added APTX capsules to bubble borders; removed portrait compartments, dividers and the previous gold effect
